name: spec
description:
Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Full lifecycle: greenfield genesis (architect → explore → design) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → optional /spec:design (mock-bound, deterministic fidelity gates) → /spec:build (direct Sonnet worker dispatch per layer wave, executed red-check) → /spec:review (spec-review-driver.js stepped, driver-stepped: deterministic legs via review-legs.js + ONE fresh-context reviewer whose non-soft findings carry executed repros; verdict derived by verdict.js) → /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.33.2 — mock hygiene and the sketch-exit matrix (specs/20260824/03-mock-states-hygiene.md): `design-atlas.js check` gains four hygiene checks, bound at `data-status` `ratified` or `approved` (or under `--matrix`), free at `sketch`: a universal `box-sizing: border-box` rule in the mock's own `<style>`; every CSS block declaring `font-size` also declares `line-height`; the `[data-screen-label]` root's class rule(s) declare neither `border` nor `border-radius`; every `data-state-btn` control sits before the root's opening tag or inside a `data-contract="none"` ancestor — and a `<style>` with unbalanced braces is a violation naming the file, never a silent skip. `ratified` and `approved` are now equivalent for every check the atlas runs (matrix rules included); the atlas keeps both badge names — `ratified` is roadmap-level provenance, `approved` is standalone-spec-level provenance. `/spec:sketch`'s exit now runs the expansion pass (media queries + the tokens dark block) and `check --matrix`, rendering the matrix screenshots for a fast confirm, before the ratify question — so on roadmap-derived mocks the matrix is confirmed once, at ratification, rather than again at `/spec:design` promotion. The mock mark vocabulary (`data-screen-label`, `data-status`, `data-state-btn`, `data-contract="none"`, `data-positioned`) is now documented in `design.md`'s harness paragraph, and the roadmap-brief template's `surfaces` comment is corrected from the stale `regionRef` reference to `data-screen-label` anchors. 
7.33.1 — the review's out-of-plan check no longer flags the pipeline's own retained evidence: `BASELINE_GLOBS` in `spec/scripts/lib/glob-match.js` gains `.claude/spec-runs/**`, the directory `spec-review-driver.js` writes via its own mandatory `--retain` on every hard-stop, escalation, and close (and `render-gate.js`'s default `--out` fallback). It already carried `.claude/spec-runs.jsonl` and `.claude/agent-memory/**` (7.31, spec 20260823/04) — this is the same omission class one directory over, observed 2026-08-24 closing UpWell spec 20260823/04 where four retained artifacts forced a waive. Second recurrence of the class, so per core.md § Incident Policy: the one-line fix plus a behavioral test (red at HEAD, green after), no standing guard, no doctrine prose. Hosts that added `.claude/spec-runs/**` to `pipelineOwnedPaths` as a stopgap can drop it. 
7.33.0 — /spec:design rebuilt on the render gate (specs/20260824/02-design-stage-on-render-gate.md): the command body is now six steps — preflight → author (direct Sonnet dispatch per surface, the mock HTML in context) → host gate → render gate → blocking user look → reconcile + `designed:` — with step position derived from disk on every invocation, never a state file. `spec-design-driver.js` (561 lines), `spec/workflows/wf-design.js`, and `skeletons-check.js` are deleted with their tests; their `spec-paths` keys (`design-driver`, `wf-design`, `skeletons-check`) and `entrypoints.json` rows are retired — those keys now exit non-zero with the usage line. Component authoring is direct Sonnet dispatch per surface rather than a skeleton-binding-map paraphrase hop — the same inversion `/spec:build` and `/spec:review` already took — with one story per mock state rendering exactly the values the mock illustrates and the render gate as the drift detector. The human catalog look is kept and blocking after both gates are green. The `.design/` sidecar, the Haiku match pass, the Fable retainer, the vision consult, and the `ITERATE` loop are gone. The frozen surface is untouched and pinned by regression tests: `spec-status.js --next` still routes `hardened`+`design: true` without `designed:` to `/spec:design` and never back once stamped, and the state gate still requires `hardened`. `render-gate.js`'s `design.render`-missing exit-2 remedy now names `/spec:design` so the command's STOP and the script's STOP are one message.
